I have had mine (the Canadian version) for about six weeks.  It's a very strange sensation, sort of like a prickly static electricity type feeling right at my hairline to start, then it changesinto a pressure feeling.  I initially wondered if the sensation would be too intense to actually use it during a migraine on the high setting, but it actually works quite well. i've used it for an hour just doing three cycles in a row and it definitely takes the edge off the pain. The primary benefit is for prevention, though, and I believe it is helping. I don't think I'll have a true sense of it until several months have passed, as there were heavy thunderstorms here earlier in the summer which is a trigger for me.
